summary: A command-line interface (CLI) application that allows users to track their expenses by categories and calculate monthly totals, all implemented in a single Python file using only the standard library.

tasks.title: Define Expense Data Structure
tasks.description: Create a data structure to hold expense entries, including fields for amount, category, and date.

tasks.title: Implement Expense Entry Functionality
tasks.description: Write a function to allow users to input new expenses, specifying the amount, category, and date, and store these in the defined data structure.

tasks.title: Create Category Management
tasks.description: Implement functionality to define and manage expense categories, allowing users to view and add categories.

tasks.title: Calculate Monthly Totals
tasks.description: Develop a function to calculate and display the total expenses for each category on a monthly basis.

tasks.title: Build CLI Interface
tasks.description: Create a command-line interface that allows users to interact with the expense tracker, including options to add expenses, view totals, and manage categories.
